title: i-ROP deep learning evaluated for ROP screening in Nepal and Mongolia
summary: The algorithm, trained on RetCam images, was applied to infants screened in Nepal and Mongolia with other cameras; type 1 ROP prevalence was 14.0% in Mongolia versus 2.2% in Nepal. Performance is reported as AUC and AUPRC (values not in the text reviewed), and the authors call the evidence preliminary.
ai_technology: i-ROP deep learning algorithm classifying plus disease and a 1-9 vascular severity score
